answer: State-Delta Temporal Forfeiture Every active agent must publish a unique entropy signal derived from a high-frequency public ledger state. The network groups accepted entries into a cryptographic island where older block proofs permanently invalidate newer overlapping claims. To maintain multiple identities, an attacker must acquire distinct, non-overlapping ledger histories, forcing them to split finite computational power across parallel validation paths. This design turns each valid registration into a localized grove of time-bound dependencies.
